answer: The terrace index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1361 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the reef. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the umber queue while genuine members promoted earlier continues earning. Each copy needs 7 hours of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
